### Follow up to #{{PREVIOUS_ISSUE}}

### Tested:
(add PRs below that are potentially breaking and need to be well tested)
- [ ] # 

### Tasks to do for new release:
- [ ] make sure to merge any `Helm Chart Updates` PR before continuing with the list below (https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+helm+)
- [ ] run [Release 1](https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/actions/workflows/release-1-build.yml) with the new version number: bumps the version in `aio-version.twig` and builds new images (watch the build at https://github.com/nextcloud-releases/all-in-one/actions/workflows/build_images.yml)
- [ ] do a last smoke test using the develop channel (See https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/blob/main/develop.md#how-to-test-things-correctly)
- [ ] test if collabora opens
- [ ] run [Release 2](https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/actions/workflows/release-2-beta.yml) with the Nextcloud version that new instances can install directly: runs the E2E tests, deploys from develop to beta, creates the `vX.Y.Z Beta` pre-release with the autogenerated changelog and a Discussion, renames the `next` milestone to the version number, creates a new `next` milestone and moves all open issues/PRs to it
- [ ] post in all issues and discussions that were fixed/implemented that this is now released with the new beta version and post how to switch to the beta channel (e.g. `This is now released with X.Y.Z Beta. Testing and feedback is welcome! See https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one#how-to-switch-the-channel`)
- [ ] wait a week and see if new bugs get reported and don't merge any PR into the main branch of this repo in the meantime!
- [ ] if not, publish to latest as describe below; if yes simply close this milestone and create a new one that includes the bugfixes and starts from the beginning of this guide
- [ ] run [Release 3](https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/actions/workflows/release-3-stable.yml): deploys from beta to latest, makes the release the stable and latest one, removes `Beta` from its title and closes its milestone
- [ ] Merge the automated `YAML updates` PR if there should  be one (https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+yaml)
- [ ] if multiple Beta versions have been pushed in the meantime without a stable release, adjust the changelog of the release - it must include all changes since the latest stable release
- [ ] close related discussion that announced the new beta release at https://github.com/nextcloud/all-in-one/discussions/categories/releases
- [ ] close this ticket
